Resolves #21638

#21585's two-line clamp still cut two Forms captions; both now read whole on every compact card. Multi-Step Account Form keeps its claim in 96 characters (was 127): each step validates and says what is wrong, and the last step shows the submitted object. Sign-up validation drops its question-shaped opener (117 → 72). `seo.json` carries the generator's own output for the two routes.

Evidence: L3 (local Portal, headless: a caption probe over every card view of both records and whole-page frames, on `dev` with #21585's clamp applied) → L3 required (AC-1 and AC-3 are rendered geometry and frames). Residual: none.
